author: Sega Jenesis
title: Hunting for digital artists for custom Pokemon binder scenes
content:
🎨 I’m on the hunt for digital artists! 👀

I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them!

I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters.

Is it a little late in the year to be looking for holiday commissions? Maybe. 😂 But here I am anyway!

Obviously, this is a PAID commission! I absolutely believe in compensating artists for their time and talent. 💚

If you’re an artist or know someone who might be interested, please send them my way! I’d love to see portfolios, pricing, and availability. 🥰

author: Romance Fiction Club
title: Hiring character artist for large project
content: We’re looking to hire a character artist who can take on a large project. Any authors have reccomendations? Human made artwork only please.

author: squirrel.35008284
title: Looking for artist for character art of two main characters
content: 🎨 Calling all artists! I’m planning to self-publish my novel within the next year and I’m looking for an artist to create character art for my two main characters. ✨ One important requirement: NO AI art or AI tools used at any stage of the process. I had a bad experience earlier this year with someone who claimed their work was fully human-made, only to discover otherwise after paying. I want to work with a real artist and support genuine creativity, and I’m happy to pay fairly for your work!

author: not_ordr
title: Looking for artist for character art, payment plan ok, no AI
content: I'm looking for an artists that can do character art for my up coming book. And who's willing to work with me because money is tight. So a lot up front wouldn't work but I can definitely pay you what you're worth. Just not up front. No AI please. I am so fucking serious no AI please!

author: nrfrh_azn
title: Looking for illustrator for YA fantasy novel
content:
🎨 Calling all fantasy illustrators!

I’m looking for an illustrator for my upcoming YA fantasy novel.

Think dark academia, ancient magic, mysterious towers and an elegant, atmospheric fantasy aesthetic. ✨

If you create fantasy book covers, I’d love to see your portfolio!

Please DM me your artwork, rates and estimated turnaround time. Recommendations are welcome too!

#FantasyIllustration #BookCoverArtist #YAFantasy
